Package models

Class Guest

java.lang.Object
models.Guest
public class Guest extends Object
Represents a hotel guest registered in the MIRAGE system.

A Guest holds personal contact information, a loyalty tier, and a running total of all spending accumulated across reservations and add-on experiences. Instances are created by the application when registering new guests and are hydrated from the database by GuestDAO.

Database mapping: guest table.

  • Constructor Details

    • Guest

      public Guest(String fullName, String email, String phone, String loyaltyTier)
      Creates a new Guest with all required profile fields. guestId is left at its default (0) until the record is persisted and the generated key is set via setGuestId(int).
      Parameters:
      fullName - the guest's full name; must not be null or blank
      email - the guest's e-mail address; must not be null or blank
      phone - the guest's phone number; may be null
      loyaltyTier - the initial loyalty tier; must be one of the accepted values
